style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, mountain noon
motion_rule: EVERY second something big crosses or fills the lens — a bill, her tail, the marmot, the banner, the herd. Lens blanked nine times; the biggest movement of the clip falls on 4.2-6.0: banner tearing loose, herd arriving. Banner snaps and dust streams all clip, speech included
camera_moves: wide; close-ups come from the animals and paper
character: a lean puma in an embroidered coat, lounging in a gilded armchair, eyes half closed, a huge DIAMOND RING on her finger, bills under one paw, an iron chain in the other; she never hurries
cast: MARMOT: fat, chewing without pause, never running, chained like a lapdog at her chair. HERD: goats and deer at full speed, never stopping
props: BANNER: ragged holed cloth on poles over the cliff, painted with a top-hatted showman and a THREE-FINGERED profit sign. CHAIR: gold, red velvet. BILLS: pale percent slips
prop_continuity: stack: full at 0.0, half at 4.2, gone at 8.0; the ring catches the sun
environment: sunlit ledge, wind-raked grass, dust streaming down the valley, blue sky, sheer drop
lighting: blazing noon, hard sun, crisp shadows, glints off the diamond

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: lazy satisfied female voice, even 4.3 syllables/sec, every word fully voiced, natural stress, voice above every effect
audio.pacing: each line is ONE unbroken phrase in its window, never split; pauses only at 1.3-1.6, 3.0-4.2, 7.0-7.5; 4.2 and 5.6 run together; voiceless after 8.0
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: cloth cracking, paper rustle and slap, chain clinking, chewing; a thud at 3.0; cloth tearing at 5.0; bleating and hooves 5.6-7.0, fading after 8.8

timeline.a: silent. A bill flies INTO THE LENS, blanks the frame, peels away: she lounges in the chair, torn banner cracking above
she leans out of the chair until her face fills the frame, bills streaming past both edges; the ring sparks into the camera
silent. The chain snaps taut across the frame, a bill spins past the lens
one phrase, no break. She throws her body around in the chair, tail sweeping the lens black end to end, then the banner bellies over the frame
silent, the loudest hit. The fat MARMOT slams into the lens on his chain, chewing face filling it, then the stack bursts and blanks it twice
she stretches full length out of the chair; the banner rips off one pole and WHIPS across the lens, blanking the frame, then peels off onto the first goats pouring in from both edges in dust
no breath. The herd tears edge to edge under the banner in a wall of dust, hooves hammering
silent, the only stop in her voice. The dust wall rolls over the lens and blanks it; only her jaw and the ring move
she whips her head into the lens, muzzle filling the frame, eyes opening wide
silent. She sweeps the last bills over the edge; through the paper the herd reaches the drop, first goats go over
silent. She rises in one graceful movement and looks down: the back rows shove the front, the herd pours into the abyss, dust boiling over the lens

must_appear: the diamond ring, the gilded chair, the chained marmot, the holed banner with the showman, the banner tearing loose, her graceful rise, the herd falling into the abyss
negative_prompt: letters, numbers, cyrillic, subtitles, watermark, night, dark scene, live people, a second puma, slow motion, the herd standing still, the chain breaking, a talking head with nothing else moving, a line split in two, muffled voice, silence in the tail, accented Russian
